source: Documented values transcribed from the project's HTML prototype as shown in the MM03 presentation (27 Jan 2026), slides 4 and 6-12. Attributes the prototype left as "To be add" are filled with illustrative sample values and tagged as such.

fields.label: Product sustainability profile
value: The battery incorporates recycled raw materials.
Renewable energy sources (solar/wind) used in production facilities.
Manufactured as per requirements of the EU Battery Regulation.

fields.label: Battery chemistry
fields.value: Solid-state lithium-metal — NMC811 cathode | LLZO garnet-oxide solid electrolyte | lithium-metal anode

fields.label: Impact of substances on environment, human health & safety
value: Lithium metal reacts with water and moisture, releasing flammable hydrogen.
NMC811 contains nickel and cobalt compounds: skin sensitisers and suspected carcinogens.
LLZO ceramic dust can irritate the lungs during production and recycling.
No flammable liquid electrolyte, which lowers the risk of fire.

fields.label: Email of manufacturer
fields.note: The prototype used a placeholder address (xyz@…). This is an illustrative address on a reserved .example domain.

fields.label: Carbon footprint as declared (kg CO₂e / kWh of total energy)
Manual for removal of the battery from the appliance
fields.value: Removal guide RM-SSC123 (rev. 1.0): switch off device, remove housing, disconnect cell tabs, release pressure plates.

fields.label: Manual for disassembly and dismantling of the battery pack
fields.value: Dismantling guide DM-SSC123 (rev. 1.0): open in a dry room, separate casing, pressure springs, current collectors and cell stack for recycling.

fields.label: Postal, e-mail and web address of sources for spare parts
fields.value: Solid State Battery Service, Berlin, 12489, Germany · parts@solid-state-battery.example · https://www.solid-state-battery.example/parts

fields.label: Safety measures / instructions
value: Do not crush, puncture or open the cell.
Keep away from water: lithium metal reacts with moisture.
Use a class D extinguisher or dry sand for lithium-metal fires.

fields.label: Supplier list
fields.note: Suppliers as listed in the prototype; illustrative, not confirmed commercial relationships.

fields.label: Packaging information
fields.value: Cells sealed in moisture-barrier aluminium-laminate bags with desiccant, in recycled cardboard boxes.

fields.label: Supplier code of conduct
fields.value: Supplier Code of Conduct v1.0 — responsible sourcing of lithium, nickel and cobalt following OECD due-diligence guidance.

fields.label: Customer-specific requirements
value: Stack pressure applied during operation: 1–3 MPa
